newsitem.title: USA: Brooke names Fulford as CEO of Liggett unit.
newsitem.headline: Brooke names Fulford as CEO of Liggett unit.

text.p: Brooke Group Ltd said Thursday its board of directors had appointed Ronald Fulford as chairman and chief executive of its Liggett Group tobacco subsidiary.
Brooke said Fulford replaces Rouben Chakalian, who stepped down as chairman but remained member of Liggett's board and became consultant for the subsidiary.
Fulford also replaces Douglas Cummins, who resigned as chief executive officer to pursue other interests, it said.
Fulford was executive chairman of Hanson PLC's Imperial Tobacco in the United Kingdom between 1987 and February 1996.
Brooke is a holding company that owns Liggett Group Inc, controls New Valley Corp and owns tobacco and real estate operations in Russia. -- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610
